title: 🏔️ Welcome to Phil's home page! 👋
body: Hi, I'm Philip. I began developing with Ruby on Rails at a New York City startup in 2007. Since then, I've grown from Developer to Senior Engineering Manager, with more than 18 years in software engineering and 8 years as a Manager and Lead Engineer.

Today with Claude Code, I build AI-powered software at Olio Apps in Portland, Oregon. I work on BlackLine's AI Account Recs 3.0 and the Daily Reading app. Outside work, I walk my dog, play live poker, and make YouTube videos. I believe in accessible computers, and I'm optimistic about the future :-)

title: Phil's Career
body: I started in tech as an analyst at Brightidea in 2007 while transitioning from mathematics and education. I taught myself Ruby on Rails, then joined readMedia as its first full-time developer. We grew the company into what Merit is today.

Today with Claude Code, I build AI-powered software at Olio Apps as a Lead Software Engineer. I work on BlackLine's AI Account Recs 3.0 and the Daily Reading app. My passion is hiring great teams to build great products with great technologies.

title: Phil's Education
body: I majored in mathematics in college and grad school, and my first career was as a teacher in New York City.
However, I always loved computers and quickly transitioned to my new career as a developer.

title: Phil's App Store
body: I often program for fun, and you can browse my side projects on GitHub.
I once wrote a Ruby script to nab myself tickets to The Daily Show, which was first-come-first-serve on its website at the time, and you never knew when tickets would become available.

title: Phil's Personal Life
body: I maintain a healthy work/life balance. Outside work, I spend time with my dog and make videos for YouTube.
I also enjoy playing chess and live poker. Check out the links below to learn more about my life outside work!

title: Let's get in touch
body: Hi there! Today with Claude Code, I build AI-powered software at Olio Apps as a Lead Software Engineer in Portland, OR.
If you've made it this far, drop me a line. Send an email and I'll speak with you soon 👍.
